title: Superfrog character visibility and continued Magic Woods gameplay
status: FIXED: direct sprite POS/CTL programming now reaches Agnus DMA; visible character, scrolling, jump/landing, collection, damage/life loss and checkpoint respawn checked
cause: Shared engine fault, reproduced under both ROMs. CPU/Copper SPRxPOS/CTL writes reached Denise but not Agnus DMA. An exhausted descriptor latch retained old vertical controls and suppressed pointed pixel-data fetches.
correction: Route CPU/Copper position/control writes into existing sprite DMA state and permit reprogramming after exhaustion. Preserve the mandatory field control reload and a pending control pair across intervening writes. No sprite data header ownership requirement or title-specific workaround.

machine.df0: Original read-only SPS 35 Disk One IPF

Team17 Superfrog instructions, preserved transcription; ordinary joystick controls and restart pill

beforeTrace.interval: Reset and original six startup input events through field 12000, then one field stepped through the existing scalar quantum using reflection. Reads private state without guest bus reads or guest-memory writes.
beforeTrace.observation: At line 32 Copper programs SPR0 pointer $538AC, POS $9C82, CTL $BF81. Denise reflects those controls, but Agnus retains POS $0007, CTL $FFFC, Active=false and Exhausted=true. No character data is fetched.

postRespawnVisibility.finding: At field 12200 the guest Copper program supplies HSTART 464/480 for all four character channels, beyond the 454-lores-pixel raster; field 12100 supplies on-screen starts. This explains the post-respawn blank snapshot independently of the repaired missing-DMA fault.

validation: Evidence and workload JSON parsed; workload equals actual initial/loaded physical input; new Markdown local links resolve; published workload bytes match; staged whitespace check passed. Native media and diagnostic tests are separate coverage.
